correctness.rationale: Explicit proof: child-count divisibility gives UD=0, word expansion yields F^(2h+1)=0. Nonzero indicator vectors of deepest two levels witness ranks 1 and 2 at powers 2h and 2h-1. Rank-nullity gives exact q-probabilities, and invariant opposite child subtrees establish the converse complete-tree nonnilpotency. Reproduced modulo 2 and 3 on 12 tree cases and 5 contrasting cases. No exhaustive finite test is substituted for the all-size proof.
